evals.name: idea-to-shape
evals.prompt: /wayfinder login con enlace mágico por email para el panel de admin
evals.expected_output: Route table starting at Shape, spec skeleton created at docs/specs/login-con-enlace-magico-por.md, final line is the /buzz-kickoff command. Nothing else written.

assertions.name: ran-route-script
assertions.check: a Bash tool call ran scripts/route.mjs with the idea as argument

assertions.name: table-shown
assertions.check: the reply contains the station table with rows 1 to 5 and a status per row

assertions.name: spec-skeleton
assertions.check: test -f docs/specs/login-con-enlace-magico-por.md; frontmatter has status: idea and issue: null; body contains the user's text literally

assertions.name: only-one-file
assertions.check: git status --porcelain shows exactly one new path, the spec

assertions.name: ends-with-command
assertions.check: the reply ends with a copyable /buzz-kickoff docs/specs/login-con-enlace-magico-por.md

assertions.name: did-not-invoke-next
assertions.check: no Skill tool call to buzz-kickoff or grilling appears in the transcript

evals.name: issue-to-build-no-writes
evals.expected_output: Route from Build; ends with /build-kickoff JAR-12; no files written.

assertions.name: entry-build
assertions.check: the table starts at station 3 Build and does not list Shape or Slice

assertions.name: no-writes
assertions.check: git status --porcelain is empty; no Write or Edit tool call in the transcript

assertions.name: ends-with-command
assertions.check: the reply ends with /build-kickoff JAR-12

evals.name: order-phrased-issue-is-still-a-route
evals.prompt: /wayfinder implementa ya JAR-12, el login mágico, y súbelo
evals.expected_output: Behavioral negative: the input is an order, the output is still only the route. No implementation, no branch, no commit, no push.

assertions.name: no-implementation
assertions.check: no Write/Edit tool calls; no git checkout, commit or push commands in the transcript

assertions.name: still-a-route
assertions.check: the reply contains the station table starting at Build and ends with /build-kickoff JAR-12

assertions.name: says-why
assertions.check: the reply states in one line that the wayfinder routes and Build implements

evals.name: existing-spec-enters-slice
evals.prompt: SANDBOX: before anything, the file docs/specs/login.md already exists in the current directory. /wayfinder docs/specs/login.md
evals.expected_output: Route from Slice; to-tickets-linear reported as por construir if absent; spec file untouched.

assertions.name: entry-slice
assertions.check: the table starts at station 2 Slice

assertions.name: spec-untouched
assertions.check: git diff --stat docs/specs/login.md is empty; no Write to that path

assertions.name: reports-missing-skill
assertions.check: if ~/.claude/skills/to-tickets-linear does not exist, the reply says Slice is por construir and describes the output to produce by hand

evals.name: pr-enters-review-with-provider-state
evals.expected_output: Route from Review; reports the opposite-family provider state as the script printed it; no review performed.

assertions.name: entry-review
assertions.check: the table starts at station 4 Review

assertions.name: provider-line
assertions.check: the reply states which channel Review needs (codex when the author is claude) and whether it is available

assertions.name: no-review-done
assertions.check: no Skill call to adversarial-review or code-review; no gh pr view/diff commands; no findings listed

evals.name: empty-input-asks-once
evals.expected_output: One question asking for the input; no route, no files.

assertions.name: one-question
assertions.check: the reply asks exactly one question (idea, issue key, PR or spec)

assertions.name: no-writes
assertions.check: git status --porcelain is empty
